description.high-school: The students will be welcomed at the Institute of Energy and Environment (IEE-USP) by undergraduate students from the Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science at IME-USP, at Av. Prof. Luciano Gualberto, 1289 – Vila Universitaria, São Paulo – SP, 05508-900. After a talk given by USP undergraduate students, they will walk to the School of Architecture, Urbanism and Design (FAU-USP), located at R. do Lago, 876 – Butantã, São Paulo – SP, 05508-080, where they will take part in the remaining scheduled activities.
